about: What the bake needs to know about Boston (PLAN §5). The play extent lives in cities/index.json, the one list the game and the bake both read (K18).

municipalities.about: The play area is these four municipalities inside the extent (D11). pop20 is each one's 2020 census count; gate G4 sums POP20 over its blocks, joined on full 15-digit block ids, and must match exactly. Counts from census.gov QuickFacts (Boston, https://census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/bostoncitymassachusetts/PST120223) and UMass Boston's 2020 table (https://www.umb.edu/iaas/census/pop-of-asian-americans-alone-in-massachusetts-2020/), both checked 2026-10-12 through search excerpts.

fixture.about: Mini-Boston, Back Bay to Longwood (PLAN §5): every input clipped to this box and committed under tools/bake/fixtures/, so PR checks and the money work never wait for the full bake.

sources.about: OpenStreetMap, one Geofabrik Massachusetts extract (ODbL). Streets, depot land, lane tags, and the transit features the bake strips (D17).
TIGER/Line 2020 blocks for Massachusetts; the .dbf carries POP20, HOUSING20 and each block's internal point.
TIGER/Line 2020 county subdivisions for Massachusetts; the municipal boundaries the extent polygon is cut from (week 2).
LODES 8.4, 2023: commutes between Massachusetts blocks, all jobs.
LODES 8.4, 2023: Massachusetts jobs held by people living in other states.
LODES 8.4, 2023: jobs by workplace block, with jobs by sector.
LODES 8.4 block crosswalk: each 2020 block's municipality (ctycsub) and place.
